breaking.change: The readouts that were named as `cell` parts, and so wore the default style's tile (fill, rim, shadow), are named for what they show and wear no role dressing: ArenaLobby.cell → ArenaLobby.state, ArenaScoreboard.cell → ArenaScoreboard.stat, IdlePrestige.cell → IdlePrestige.readout, RacingLapHud.cell → RacingLapHud.readout, RacingResults.cell → RacingResults.place, RacingStandings.cell → RacingStandings.place, RhythmDifficulty.cell → RhythmDifficulty.rating, RhythmResults.cell → RhythmResults.readout, RhythmScoreHud.cell → RhythmScoreHud.readout, RhythmSongSelect.cell → RhythmSongSelect.fact, StrategyWave.cell → StrategyWave.readout, table.cell → table.entry. A `cell` is now only a tile the player picks (an item, a card, an ability, a slot).
breaking.fix: Rename the selectors in your style pack or game CSS (`[part="RacingLapHud.cell"]` → `[part="RacingLapHud.readout"]`, `::part(RacingLapHud\.cell)` → `::part(RacingLapHud\.readout)`), and drop any rule that only undid the tile on them. To keep a readout's tile look, give its new part the `--cell-*` fill, rim and shadow yourself.
